QuestInfo.name: Making a Tonic
QuestInfo.0: You brought Ryden fresh Octopus Legs that will be used to make Lady Syl's tonic. Wonder how it's coming along? Go talk to #bRyden#k.
QuestInfo.2: You can only hope that the tonic will make Lady Syl feel better...
QuestInfo.1: It seems that herbs are required to complete the tonic. Use the portal on the right side of Kerning City and hunt the #rDark Stumps#k found in Perion's Dusty Wind Hill. Gather the #bLeaves#k they drop.

0.0: #h0#, I'm glad you're here. \r\n#L0##bIs something wrong?#l\n#k
0.1: I just realized that the most important ingredients in a tonic are herbs. Can you bring me some herbs while I keep my eyes on the tonic?

yes.0: Take the portal at the right side of Kerning City and pass the Six Path Crossway to reach Perion's Dusty Wind Hill, where you'll find the Dark Stumps. Hunt the #rDark Stumps#k and bring back #b10 Leaves#k. You must do it before the tonic is finished.

no.0: But the tonic can't be completed without the herbs...

1.0: Oh, you've returned! I was busy stoking the fire, because the embers were getting too cool. Quick, give me the herbs.

yes.0: Aah, this should do it. Now, I need to bring it to Lady Syl. I will have a new mission for you soon so come see me again.

item.0: Take the portal at the right side of Kerning City and pass the Six Path Crossway to reach Perion's Dusty Wind Hill, where you'll find the Dark Stumps. Hunt the #rDark Stumps#k and bring back #b10 Leaves#k.
